notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened Release Date Revealed
notes.content:
Greetings detectives,

The sun has risen, and the fog dissipates as today is a big day! Firstly, our release date trailer is here so watch it now! Experience a tale of untold Lovecraft-based horror with a cult appearing from a dark abyss to wreck all that we hold dear. Will we cure madness or be driven deeper into its grasp?

[previewyoutube=wV0Dmvxjld4;full][/previewyoutube]
This story will be in your hands when Sherlock Holmes The Awakened releases on April 11, 2023! Write it down on a piece of paper and nail it on a wall nearby.

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened will be available in three editions: Standard Edition, Deluxe Edition (includes The Whispered Dreams DLC - bonus side quests and 6 new outfits) and Premium Edition (the above plus digital artbook and soundtrack).

Pre-order today to receive an additional 3 custom The Sleuth’s Attire outfits for Holmes as a bonus.
We cannot wait to share this adventure with you. Not long to go now. 

See you soon,
Your Team Frogwares

notes.title: Frogwares Publisher Sale is On Right Now
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

Today is a special day in our offices. As of right now, this moment (well, roughly this moment) our studio is 21 years old. Pretty much, it’s our birthday, and we’re having a party. 

It’s been 21 years of work, commitment, dedication, sweat, moments of tears and also of happiness. We have a whole bank filled with stories and memories from all of these years. Perhaps one day we’ll share them with you over coffee, or a blog post. 

But one thing we have to say today is this. Thank you, yes you!, for all your support, your trust, and for being the best community and fandom we could ever ask for.

On this special occasion, we have prepared a huge sale for all our games just for you. The sale will last from 2nd of August to 16th of August 2021 right here on Steam. Get ready, mark these dates in your calendar, and prepare yourself for an 80% discount! Maybe there’s a game missing from your collection?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/frogwares]Click here to visit the Frogwares Publisher Sale page[/url]

Enjoy the sale, thanks for your continuous support, and speak to you soon!

Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One | Playtime, voice cast, disguise and more news!
notes.content:
Hello Holmes, 

It seems that quite a few individuals have been asking all sorts of questions about you. Your arrival on the island has definitely got people talking. I’ve just found out that the good folks at Frogwares have collated some of those questions from “social media”, whatever that is, and created this extensive answer video for you to take a look at. It should give you more of an idea of what’s coming ahead in your next adventure. 

[previewyoutube=nM94LTzcOsc;full][/previewyoutube]

I’m glad to hear that you’re doing well, Sherry, even though the times are “testing” to say the least. Don’t worry, I’ll be speaking with you very soon. And I’m always here when you need me. 

Your friend, 

Jon

notes.title: Frogwares games soundtracks are out now. All games -70%
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Music plays an integral part in any game. It is the underlying current that sets the scene, the feeling, and the tone of a game. We might not always notice it when it’s there, but if you take it away, you will definitely feel that something is not right. And the wrong music at the wrong time can feel more awkward than asking the name of a person you’ve already met.
Today, we decided to release the music and soundtracks from our games and we bundled them in four distinct packages. Here’s a little breakdown of one another.

[u]Sherlock Holmes Classic Soundtrack[/u]
Venture into the mysterious world of the Sherlock Holmes adventures with this original soundtrack that captures the enigmatic mood of the classic games. A must-have for fans of the brilliant detective or thrilling orchestra music.

Includes soundtracks from Sherlock Holmes: The Mystery of the Mummy, Sherlock Holmes: The Silver Earring, Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - Remastered Edition, Sherlock Holmes – Nemesis, Sherlock Holmes versus Jack the Ripper.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250110/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Classic_Soundtrack/

[u]Sherlock Holmes Modern Soundtrack[/u]
Discover the enchanting vibes of Sherlock Holmes games through this original soundtrack that includes music from the latest three adventures. Combining the iconic sounds of classical orchestra instruments with a modern electronic ambient style, this collection offers more than 50 tracks and is available in MP3 320 kbps.

Includes soundtracks from The Testament of Sherlock Holmes, Sherlock Holmes: Crimes and Punishments, Sherlock Holmes: The Devil's Daughter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252260/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Modern_Soundtrack/
 
[u]Frogwares Classic Games Soundtrack[/u]
From energizing dance rhythms in 80 Days, to soul-stirring gothic tones of Dracula, this soundtrack offers a nostalgic look back at the Frogwares classic games. This is not just music – this is an insight into how it all began almost two decades ago.

This soundtrack includes music from Journey to the Center of the Earth, 80 Days, Dracula: Origin, Dracula: Love Kills, Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles, Department 42: The Mystery of the Nine, Secret Missions: Mata Hari and the Kaiser's Submarines, Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Frozen City, Sherlock Holmes and The Mystery of Osborne House, Secret Mission: The Forgotten Island

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250710/Frogwares_Games_Classic_Soundtrack/

We know that music is a powerful thing, and we hope that if you had a great time with our games, that these musical pieces will bring back some of those memories. And if you haven’t played our games before, and you’re tempted to take the plunge, our games are now -70% off on Steam. If there ever was a time to try, it’s basically now. 


Regards,

Frogwares team

notes.title: Even Prices May Die: Magrunner Free In GOG Sale
notes.content:
“Well worth the price of admission,” our Jim said of first-person puzzler Magrunner: Dark Pulse. He had a few reservations, sure, a little dissatisfaction, yes, but overall enjoyed the charms of “Portal with magnets and Cthulhu.” If it was worth parting with your hard-earned money for, why, one would need to have their mind warped by exposure to impossible horrors to not get it for free.

As part of its big summer sale, GOG are offering Magrunner for free to lure people over to have a gander at all the shiny bargains it has lined up. The stars are only aligned for 24 hours, though, and at 2pm tomorrow the offer will escape through a crack in the world.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Wot I Think – Magrunner: Dark Pulse
notes.content:
There are some games I can see coming from over the horizon. The glow of burgeoning hype – and sometimes the glow of special novelty, or sheer awesome – is so bright that you just can’t miss them. Other games, hmm, they pretty much have to be on the same street before I spot them. Whether they will then turn my head as they pass, well, that can come down to any number of things. Usually, though, it’s whether they manage to scatter a few intriguing ideas in my path, so that I have to pay attention.

In the case of Magrunner I’ve been peering at from miles off. Because it just looks that interesting. To use the crude shorthand of thematic conventions, and to get you up to speed: it’s Portal with Magnets versus Cthulhu. That’s a checklist of ideas that I can’t help taking an interest in.

Now that it’s been released, here’s wot I think.

(more…)

notes.title: Now Available - Magrunner: Dark Pulse
notes.content:
Magrunner: Dark Pulse is Now Available on Steam! Germany, Austria & Switzerland will become available on June 21st.

Magrunner: Dark Pulse is an action-puzzle game in which technology confronts the Cthulhu Mythos, as imagined by author, H. P. Lovecraft.

You are Dax, one of seven Magrunners selected among the elite to participate in MagTech Corporation's space training program. But, what should be the chance of a lifetime quickly becomes a horrific nightmare.

Equipped with your Magtech glove, you must harness the ability to magnetically polarize and manipulate objects in the environment to survive and surpass challenging puzzles. Your reflexes and ingenuity will be pushed to their limits as you make your way through 40+ immense and dangerous levels, including high-tech training rooms and the endless chasms of the lost cosmos, on a path to confront the horrendous creatures of Cthulhu!

notes.title: MAGRUNNER DARK PULSE, THE PC LAUNCH TRAILER!
notes.content:
Magrunner Dark Pulse, the action/physics game from Frogwares studio, is now available on PC! On this occasion, we are pleased to share with you an impressive launch trailer! 

In the near future, 2048, a handful of young and brilliant citizens have been chosen by Gruckezber Corporation to join the Magtech training program for space exploration. Equipped with a special glove using Gruckezber's technology, the candidates have to solve their way through a huge maze of challenge rooms, by magnetically charging objects that will attract or repel each other. But what seemed to be the chance of a lifetime for the candidates 
will soon turn into a nightmare, as they will have to survive a high-tech world gone mad. A real descent in hell, perfectly illustrated in the launch trailer of Magrunner!


Magrunner Dark Pulse will be available today for download on PC!

[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H2nKu4z-z3o]WATCH THE VIDEO[/url]
